description.value: Vancouver's oldest pub, The Lamplighter has operated since 1925 in the heart of historic Gastown, in a building that dates to 1899 when it opened as The Dominion Hotel. The 4,000 sq ft brick-lined venue features stained glass windows, a street-level patio, 50 beers on tap, arcade games, and a DJ booth—and holds the distinction of being the first beer parlour licence issued in BC after Prohibition. Operated by the Donnelly Group's Freehouse Collective, it sits on Water Street within easy reach of the Gastown cycling network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the OSM name, address (92 Water St Vancouver BC), and phone (604-687-4424). The website explicitly lists 'Takeout' and 'Wheelchair Accessible' as features, and the events-booking subpage confirms 'Patio, Pool Table, Pinball, Arcade Games, Coat Check, 50 Beers on Tap' for the Lamplighter. No bike parking, bike rack, water refill, Wi-Fi, or washroom information appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website displayed 'Closed Today' at time of fetch; OSM opening hours show the pub is closed Monday and Tuesday, so this likely reflects a normal weekly closure rather than permanent closure.
Website lists an email address (lamplighter@freehouse.co) not present in the OSM record — may be worth adding to the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate and well-established Food & Drink stop in Gastown, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A follow-up to verify at minimum bike parking or rack availability would allow a confident 'include' decision.
